study.title: DM_CorrMatch: a semi-supervised semantic segmentation framework for rapeseed flower coverage estimation using UAV imagery
study.short_title: DM_CorrMatch (diffusion + Vision Mamba); flower IoU 0.886, F1 0.941

segmentation.domain: semi-supervised semantic segmentation of yellow rapeseed (Brassica napus L.) inflorescences from UAV-RGB imagery for flower-coverage estimation / phenotyping, breeding-support application
models_tested: DM_CorrMatch (proposed: Mamba-DeepLabv3+ with Vision Mamba inserted between ResNet101 layer1/layer2, AUL label-update, DDPM generative augmentation)
plus 4 traditional methods (Otsu, HSV, K-means, color features)
segmentation.best_model: DM_CorrMatch (with diffusion): Precision 0.942, Recall 0.940, IoU 0.886, F1 0.941, Accuracy 0.940 (semi-supervised, 30 labeled + 900 unlabeled); note the without-diffusion variant instead reached IoU 0.893 (Table 5)

dataset.name: Rapeseed Flower Segmentation Dataset (RFSD): 720 high-definition UAV-RGB images (256x256 crops) collected 2021 (training) and 2022 (robustness) at Yangluo Experimental Station, Oil Crops Research Institute, CAAS, Wuhan (plots 8 m2 and 6 m2)
dataset.note: DJI Phantom 4 Pro V2.0, 20.1 MP (5472x3648), automatic flight at 10 m AGL, 75% heading/side overlap, 1.9 m/s, orthomosaic via Agisoft PhotoScan, Labelme annotation. Semi-supervised training: 30 labeled + 900 unlabeled images (DDPM-generated). GSD not stated explicitly; model robustness across different GSD/flight altitudes evaluated.

segmentation.backbone: ResNet101 (DeepLabv3+) with bidirectional Vision Mamba (state-space) blocks between layer1 and layer2; encoder-decoder ASPP

mIoU.quote: achieving an Intersection over Union (IoU) of 0.886, Precision of 0.942, and Recall of 0.940
mIoU.ambiguity: Binary flower/background segmentation; IoU is the single flower-class IoU (approx. mIoU). Recorded for the final with-diffusion config (IoU 0.886); the without-diffusion variant on the same 30/900 setting reached IoU 0.893 (best value in Table 5).

mPA.ambiguity: Reported 'Accuracy' (Eq. 10) is global pixel accuracy (TP+TN)/all, not class-mean pixel accuracy.

F1.quote: achieving an Intersection over Union (IoU) of 0.886, Precision of 0.942, and Recall of 0.940
F1.ambiguity: F1 = harmonic mean of Precision/Recall (Eq. 9); with-diffusion config 0.941.

Dice.ambiguity: Dice coefficient not reported (F1 score reported as 2.PR/(P+R)); Dice loss only used during training.

PA.ambiguity: Reported as 'Accuracy' = (TP+TN)/(TP+TN+FP+FN), i.e. global pixel accuracy.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed classes absent; task is rapeseed flower vs background.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Per-class F1 for flower/background not broken out; overall F1 0.941.

edge.framework: Pytorch-style training; base network Mamba-DeepLabv3+ (84.54 GFLOPs, 76.78 M params); no edge deployment or quantization

params_M.quote: the parameter count reaching its maximum at 76.78 million
params_M.ambiguity: Model-level structural parameter count for the final DM_CorrMatch (with diffusion) config; NOT edge-deployed.

gflops.quote: the model achieves better performance metrics, with an IoU of 0.886. However, this comes at the cost of computational complexity peaking at 84.54 GFLOPs
gflops.ambiguity: Model-level structural FLOPs (Table 2 and Table 5: 84.54 G); Table 3 lists the same Mamba-DeepLabv3+ at 85.54 GFLOPs - minor internal inconsistency.

issues: Binary flower/background segmentation; primary metric IoU (0.886) is single flower-class, recorded from the final with-diffusion config matching the abstract. Notably the without-diffusion variant reached IoU 0.893 (Table 5).
Computational efficiency is reported as structural model FLOPs/params only (84.54 G / 76.78 M) with no edge/real-time inference metrics.
Internal inconsistency in Mamba-DeepLabv3+ FLOPs (84.54 vs 85.54 G) across Tables 2/5 and Table 3.
GSD not stated explicitly; UAV altitude robustness assessed qualitatively.
